core_claim: In a one-hour stand-up special, the loudest laugh is not the funniest line — it is the line where the most structure converges, and Ali Wong's Baby Cobra gives us seconds-by-seconds proof.

edt_01.label: Hook — One ten-second laugh
edt_01.title: One ten-second laugh
edt_01.editorial_notes: 10s exact. The climax line must appear verbatim: 'Colonize the colonizer.'

edt_02.label: The shape of the hour
edt_02.title: The shape of the hour
edt_02.editorial_notes: 20.7% and 727s should remain exact. Minute 11 is the peak — the chart should make that visible.

edt_03.label: A six-level tree
edt_03.title: A six-level tree, not a flat list
edt_03.editorial_notes: The depth-vs-laugh point is structurally crucial. Show level on x, average laugh on y, max laugh as a second mark. An interactive that lets the reader explore the tree itself would land here.

edt_04.label: Anatomy of the climax
edt_04.title: Anatomy of the climax
edt_04.editorial_notes: Load-bearing section. The chart must show the 24-second staircase: 1s → 3s → 4s → 10s. Do not soften the climax line. The Netflix clip belongs here.

edt_05.label: Callbacks at thirty-three minutes
edt_05.title: Callbacks at thirty-three minutes
edt_05.editorial_notes: Three callbacks. Their reach distances (12, 33, 46 minutes) should be visible at a glance. Atmosphere video here helps with section pacing — animate a still showing arc-of-time.

edt_06.label: Marriage spine, pregnancy punch
edt_06.title: Marriage is the spine, pregnancy is the punch
edt_06.editorial_notes: Chapter-level chart with span and laughter side by side. Marriage is 30:40, dwarfs everything else.

edt_07.label: Closing — comedy as architecture
edt_07.title: Comedy is architecture
edt_07.editorial_notes: End on tension — the joke isn't the joke. A single quiet image (architectural metaphor: arch, keystone, scaffolding) is the right closer; no chart.
